Collette Ijeoma is redefining what's possible in field marketing. As Field Marketing Lead for SAP's UKI region, she's built a portfolio of 11 custom AI automations using Claude Code — turning hours of manual work into seconds of insight and saving her team hundreds of hours every week.

The Claude AI Skills Portfolio

What started as an experiment with AI-assisted workflows has become a comprehensive automation suite that touches every aspect of field marketing operations — from event registration analysis to pipeline intelligence to stakeholder communications.

Collette's complete automation portfolio — 11 custom tools built on Claude Code

The Automations

Event Registrations Analysis

Cleans raw registration exports, enriches with AE/BDC/IAC data, splits SAP internals, builds a formatted dashboard.

Replaces ~2 hrs manual VLOOKUP work per event

Master Account Event Analysis

Cross-references attendees against the MAL with exact + fuzzy matching; colour-coded RBC status output.

Full account intelligence in <2 min vs half a day

MAL Lookup

Enriches any prospect or lead file with MAL intelligence (AE, BDC, IAC, RBC, revenue) on demand.

On-demand account data without manual Excel lookups

BTP AE Email Notifications

Auto-drafts and sends personalised emails to BTP AEs listing their customers registered for each event.

Saves ~30 min per event; zero missed follow-ups

MSO D&AI Opportunity Dashboard

Builds the monthly Data & AI + BTP pipeline dashboard from the latest MSO report automatically.

Monthly pipeline review ready in minutes not hours

Zero Value Opportunity Emails

Identifies zero-value pipeline rows and drafts targeted chase emails to owners; preview before send.

Consistent pipeline hygiene with no manual triage

MSO vs Event Registrations

Cross-references all MSO pipeline accounts against every FY24–26 event registration file; pivot output.

Proves marketing event influence on live pipeline

Inbox Management

Scans Outlook, exports prioritised Excel dashboard with colour coding, AI-drafted responses, and one-click Outlook draft creation.

Cuts email triage time by ~60%

Inbox Unactioned Tracker

Identifies every email in the last 14 days that hasn't been replied to and exports to Excel for review.

Zero missed stakeholder emails

Newsletter Article Sourcing

Searches SAP + external sources (CFO Dive, Gartner, MIT Sloan) for verified articles from the last 14 days.

Real, validated content — no placeholder URLs

BDC & AI Weekly Newsletter

Generates persona-targeted HTML newsletter (CTO, CDO, CFO, Architect, Dev) aligned to Autonomous Enterprise narrative.

Weekly enablement asset produced in <5 min
"Turning hours of manual work into seconds of insight"
— The philosophy behind Collette's automation portfolio

Why This Matters

Collette's work demonstrates what happens when a marketer truly embraces AI as a force multiplier. Rather than waiting for IT to build tools or purchasing expensive platforms, she identified repetitive, time-consuming tasks and built solutions herself using Claude Code.

The result? A field marketing operation that runs with unprecedented efficiency. Event follow-ups happen automatically. Pipeline intelligence is available on demand. Stakeholder communications never fall through the cracks. And the team can focus on what matters most: building relationships and driving revenue.

Key Takeaways for PMMs

  • Start with your biggest time sinks — Collette targeted tasks that took hours of manual work
  • Build incrementally — each automation solves one specific problem well
  • Focus on data enrichment — connecting different data sources creates outsized value
  • Automate communications — personalised outreach at scale without the manual effort
  • Prove marketing impact — use automation to connect events to pipeline outcomes
